rules.about: BUG-052: FB0 on MINHAROT-1 is written 0.3mA-TYPE"A". No RCD has 0.3 mA: the amps value with the mA unit. Read as amps, never under a default
BUG-070: an mcb is no mcb above the largest current the catalog has for one (25.26.100's Q0, 3×80A); typed again by its current
rules.about_upper: BUG-077: the converse. An mccb within the catalog's mcb range, with no MCCB written beside it, no series or SKU written and no designator prefix that names an mccb (Q), is typed again by its current (25.26.100's five 40A field breakers; the user: no 40A MCCB there)
